Joins Montgomery tracts with 2026 code violation counts and CDC high blood pressure prevalence, computes violations per 1,000 total population, and returns the cross-tract correlation and paired tract count with tracts ranked by violation rate.
sql:
WITH cv AS (
  SELECT 
    geoid,
    CAST(n AS DOUBLE) AS violations_count
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261024_677bd5'
    AND source = 'm1_city'
    AND grp = 'all'
),
cdc AS (
  SELECT
    tractfips AS geoid,
    CAST(totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS total_population,
    CAST(bphigh_crudeprev AS DOUBLE) AS bp_high_prev
  FROM session.fw_677bd5_m2_cdc
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    t.geoid,
    t.name,
    COALESCE(c.violations_count, 0) AS violations_count,
    d.total_population,
    d.bp_high_prev,
    CASE 
      WHEN d.total_population IS NOT NULL AND d.total_population > 0 
      THEN (COALESCE(c.violations_count, 0) / d.total_population) * 1000 
    END AS code_violations_per_1000_total_population
  FROM fw_pg.tracts t
  LEFT JOIN cv c ON t.geoid = c.geoid
  LEFT JOIN cdc d ON t.geoid = d.geoid
)
SELECT
  name,
  code_violations_per_1000_total_population,
  violations_count,
  total_population,
  bp_high_prev,
  CORR(code_violations_per_1000_total_population, bp_high_prev) OVER () AS violation_bp_correlation,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN code_violations_per_1000_total_population IS NOT NULL AND bp_high_prev IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) OVER () AS paired_tracts,
  geoid
FROM base
ORDER BY 
  code_violations_per_1000_total_population DESC NULLS LAST,
  name ASC
LIMIT 200
